featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie expects 1,000x more tokens to flow through cyber agents soon. As the attack surface grows, keeping up is nearly impossible — large companies barely managed it before, and most companies never could. Agent swarms will fan out, use any security tool, test attack permutations, read logs and assess enterprise data risk. This capability only emerged in the past few months, enabled by long-running agents, good-enough computer use and models trained deeply on cyber. He sees huge opportunity across ide…
featured.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 判断，网络安全 Agent 处理的 token 量很快会比今天多 1000 倍。攻击面持续膨胀，大公司过去都勉强跟得上，大多数企业根本没有资源；而未来的 Agent 集群可以并行展开、调用任意安全工具、模拟各种攻击变体、读日志、评估企业数据风险。他强调这种能力是最近几个月才出现的——依赖长时运行 Agent、computer use 成熟以及模型在安全领域的深度训练。他认为身份、防火墙、网络、代码扫描、数据保护等安全栈每一层都有巨大机会，也是攻防平衡可以乐观的一个理由。

featured.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
featured.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch shared two reflections on working with AI. First: sometimes you over-guide the AI (it knows better and is smarter than you), sometimes you under-guide it (it goes off-track, has wrong biases, misses context) — managing this well is the "#0 skill" he hires for. Second: he loves the models' engineering vernacular — gate, evidence, culprit, durable, provenance, contract — because most engineering is debugging and understanding existing systems, i.e. forensics. He wonders what the minimum vi…
featured.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 发了两条关于"如何与 AI 协作"的思考。第一条：用 AI 有时会过度指导（它其实比你懂、比你聪明），有时又指导不足（它会跑偏、带错误偏见、缺上下文），把握好这个度是他招人时看重的"第 0 号技能"。第二条：他很喜欢模型的工程术语——gate、evidence、culprit、durable、provenance、contract——因为大部分工程工作本质是调试和理解既有系统，像侦探/审计员做取证；他好奇高效工作所需的"最小可用英语"是多少，ASD-STE100 简化技术英语约 900 个词，他怀疑实际需要的更少。

featured.title: Jev: The AI That Makes Decisions, Not Text (Diogo Almeida)
featured.summaryEn: AI's biggest value lies not in chat boxes but in being embedded in software like logic gates — Jev replaces LLMs for workflow automation with programmable, composable "System 1" decision models that return probabilities, betting that intelligence per dollar is the future. Diogo Almeida is CEO of TypeSafe, the company behind Jev, and a co-inventor of RLHF. At recording, TypeSafe had just announced an $870M Series A at a $7.5B valuation; within three weeks of launch it saw 40M video views, ~1M daily users, a trillion tokens a day and a third of the Fortune 500. He describes two years of stealth as deliberate "under-promise, over-deliver," and says the product, not marketing, is carrying the company. His core thesis is "machine-native AI": LLMs have been a chat box beside software, while software's power comes from reliably composing logic gates. In an email-scheduling example, LLM systems…
featured.insightZh: AI 真正的大规模价值不在聊天框，而在像逻辑门一样嵌进软件——Jev 用可编程、可组合、返回概率的"系统 1 决策模型"替代 LLM 做工作流自动化，主张"intelligence per dollar"才是未来。 Diogo Almeida 是 TypeSafe（Jev 背后的公司）CEO、RLHF 的共同发明者之一。节目录制时 TypeSafe 刚宣布 8.7 亿美元 A 轮、估值 75 亿美元；发布三周内视频 4000 万播放、日活约百万、日处理一万亿 token、覆盖三分之一财富 500 强。他说公司隐身两年是有意的"少承诺多交付"——业界普遍过度承诺，而 Jev 是靠开发者自己玩出结果才爆发的。他没有市场团队，认为是产品在带动营销。 他的核心论点是"机器原生 AI"：LLM 一直是挂在软件旁边的聊天框，而软件的力量来自可靠的逻辑门不断组合。以邮件日程助理为例，LLM 方案靠不断膨胀的系统提示"祈祷模型别出错"，复杂度越高错误率越高；Jev 方案是把每个判断拆成独立分类器（"聪明的 if 语句"），每个都可评估、不会被遗忘，出错可加入 eval，并返回概率让开发者按场景自定义阈值（如 Disney 与 Character AI 的拒答阈值完全不同）。他认为被叫作"分类器"是夸奖——Facebook、TikTok、Google 都靠分类器运转，且通用分类是"AI 完全"问题。 在技术上，他认为 RLHF 让模型为讨好人类而优化，带来谄媚、过度拒答、风格单一，并严重抬高了人们对自动化的预期；RLVR 擅长刷基准，但模型依然"95% 爱因斯坦、5% 憨豆先生"，不告诉你何时是憨豆就无法自动化。Jev 用自研的 RLCD 训练、自建数据，基于多个开源权重模型改造，不做预训练（他称预训练是"浪费资源的垃圾火"）。对 Cloudflare、Databricks、Microsoft、OpenAI Decisions 等三周内跟进的"模仿者"，他认为接口好抄、可靠性难做，并点赞 OpenAI 没发布误导性基准。他不认为我们走在递归自我改进的路上，但认为"AI 在自动化上毫无用…

items.title: Ryo Lu · Cursor 设计负责人（曾任职 Notion、Stripe）
items.summaryEn: Cursor design lead Ryo Lu published a long essay, "struggle together." He learned programming and design by trying, failing and trying again, until hard-won lessons became intuition. Now we can just ask a machine, and he wonders what happens when we remove difficulty before understanding what it taught us. He also worries that always-patient agents make it easier to avoid the discomfort of working with people — where many deep friendships begin. Since these agents run on company-owned server farms, he asks whether…
items.insightZh: Cursor 设计负责人 Ryo Lu 发了一篇长文《struggle together》。他回顾自己通过反复尝试、失败、再尝试学会编程和设计，那些修不好的 bug、看似正确却被用户用坏的设计，最终沉淀为直觉。现在我们可以直接问机器，结果"够用"就继续，但他担心在理解困难教会了我们什么之前就把困难移除了；更担心 Agent 永远耐心、随叫随到，让人更少去经历与他人合作时的不适与磨合——而很多深厚友谊正是从中诞生。这些 Agent 运行在公司拥有的服务器上，他追问这是自由还是"舒适的禁锢"，呼吁做能帮人更多走进世界、找到彼此的工具，像爵士乐队一样一起做出单人做不出的音乐。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons 普通合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO
items.summaryEn: SPC General Partner and former Dropbox CTO Aditya Agarwal says one weird effect of being "max AI pilled" is that he has started to truly treasure IRL time with family and friends. Put on some techno, dance with friends, take your kids to the park, let the agents cook (or not) — but celebrate humans. A nice echo of Ryo Lu's essay.
items.insightZh: South Park Commons 普通合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO Aditya Agarwal 说，彻底"AI 上头"之后的一个奇怪效应是：他开始格外珍惜与家人朋友的线下时光。放点 techno、和朋友跳舞、带孩子去公园，让 Agent 去干活（或者不干），但一定要"歌颂人类"。与 Ryo Lu 的长文形成了有意思的呼应。

items.title: Swyx · Latent Space / smol.ai 创始人
items.summaryEn: Latent Space's Swyx announced that @latentspacepod is building a new editorial team, hiring writers, reviewers and reporters (contact @ricmac and @adlinzainal), with part-time and one-off guest posts also welcome. He plans to put a version of his shared note into the welcome package for every hire.
items.insightZh: Latent Space 主理人 Swyx 宣布 @latentspacepod 正在组建新的编辑团队，招聘撰稿人、审稿人和记者（联系 @ricmac 和 @adlinzainal），也欢迎兼职和一次性客座投稿；他还会把一份写作理念放进每位新成员的入职包里。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人
items.summaryEn: OpenAI Codex lead Thibault Sottiaux posted "Day 20/ Rest and reset," said it would land by midnight PST, then confirmed "It is all propagated" — enjoy some mad codexing tomorrow, with a fun week ahead.
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 发帖称"第 20 天：休息与重置"，并表示将在太平洋时间午夜前完成；随后确认"已全部生效"，让大家明天尽情使用 Codex，并预告接下来一周还有好玩的东西。

items.title: Peter Yang · Roblox 产品负责人、AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: Peter Yang recommended kids' reading app @once_reading — the only learning app he and his 4-year-old have stuck with for months, thanks to a daily parent-kid habit, light gamification (a silly photo after each lesson), and real books mailed after 30 lessons. Separately, he called some news he could hardly believe "a huge bummer for Claude users," praising Anthony and Thariq as two of the best at listening to users (the tweet doesn't detail the specifics).
items.insightZh: Peter Yang 推荐了儿童阅读 App @once_reading：这是他和 4 岁女儿唯一坚持了几个月的学习 App，原因是它要求家长每天陪学、有轻量游戏化（每课后拍张搞怪合照）、完成 30 课后会寄书让孩子独立阅读。另一条他表示难以相信但确认属实的消息对 Claude 用户是"巨大的遗憾"，并称 Anthony 和 Thariq 是最擅长倾听用户的两个人（原推未展开具体细节）。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari shared a piece he says articulates his thesis of evolving from context → harnesses → judgement, inviting builders in this space to jam on product ideas. He is also looking for helpful angels to join an infra Series A.
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 分享了一篇文章，称它更好地阐述了他所说的"从 context → harness → judgement 的演进"，邀请在这一方向做产品的人找他交流；同时他在为一家基础设施公司的 A 轮寻找愿意投资的天使。
